title: Plastic audit tally sheet
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Ecosystems (7D); atoms, elements and molecules (7H)
source: Seeded from science/y7 lesson 54 (Plastic audit tally sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 54: Effects on the environment: our impact. To understand how human activity affects ecosystems and how we can protect them

questions.q: Explain how cutting down a hedgerow can reduce biodiversity.
questions.a: It destroys the habitat and food of many species, so they leave or die
questions.model: Habitat gives food and shelter. Remove it: birds, insects and small mammals lose both. Fewer species: less biodiversity.

questions.a: A species brought to a new area that spreads and harms native ones

questions.q: Give one way to conserve a habitat.
questions.a: e.g. a nature reserve or planting hedges

questions.q: Write a short report in the portal response box on one human impact: what it is, how it harms an ecosystem, and two solutions. Starter: 'One way humans harm ecosystems is ...'
questions.a: A paragraph with impact, effect and two realistic solutions
questions.model: Teacher models the first sentence: 'One way humans harm ecosystems is plastic pollution in the sea, which animals mistake for food.'

questions.q: Do a 1-week home plastic audit plan: what will you count and how will you reduce it?
questions.a: A sensible plan with a tally table

questions.q: Why is high biodiversity good for an ecosystem?
questions.a: More species and links mean it copes better with change

questions.q: Big question: why are there fewer red squirrels now?
questions.a: Grey squirrels out-compete them for food and spread a disease that kills them.
